**Security: pass** at `46463da5e676de2196d828cf028c3727e0731be7`.

No high-confidence exploitable security finding remains in the reviewed PR-owned changes.

S001 is closed: printed release repairs quote the complete role/instance argument, seat and project through `shell_word`; the hostile-instance `/bin/sh` round-trip case passed in exact-head CI. F004 retarget addresses and JSON placeholders also use `shell_word`.

F002 is repaired: an unheld live-requester FYI returns `E-RS-DIRECTORY-NOT-TOLD` before withdrawal, and the same command completes the remaining work on retry. Unknown/tombstoned requesters are listed in `data.gone`, with `requester_gone` on the withdrawal event. Withdrawal remains scoped to the specified project, role and queued state across instances. Request bodies go only to the exact requester's FYI, not refusal projections or withdrawal events.

Admission guards accompany independently owned mutations; delivery/requeue guards remain intact. Batch assignment checks retired standing under the writer lock rather than bypassing admission. Existing any-seat local directory-management authority is intentional and is distinct from lineage/output-answer authority.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42367678850](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42367678850) succeeded. JUnit lists 2,078 passing cases, including tell-first refusal/retry, shell round-trip, retarget, cancelled-waiter and shared-admission cases. Source and CI review only; no local builds/tests, credential reads, exploit execution, product changes or live probes.

Reviewed `3ecec77..46463da` and the PR-owned changes, excluding imported main changes. No global Git/DB/pointer/notification atomicity is claimed: a role commit can already have landed when tell-first refuses. No credential disclosure found in reviewed changed material; resolved lockfile sources remain exclusively `registry.npmjs.org`, with seven-day npm quarantine retained. Historical scrubbing and deployment proof are not claimed.
